DESK_CONNECT_FIRST_HINT: Connect a bridge, then read a pack.
DESK_CONN_DEMO_TITLE: NO HARDWARE? TRY A DEMO PACK
DESK_CONN_ERR_NORESP: No response from the bridge. On the PocketOBI, open Tools › PC bridge (or enable it at boot), then Connect again.
DESK_CONN_ERR_OPEN: Cannot open %s — is another program using it (Arduino IDE serial monitor, etc.)?
DESK_CONN_OPENING: Opening %s and waiting for the bridge…
DESK_CONN_PICK_PORT: Pick a valid serial port first.
DESK_CONN_TIP: Tip: on the PocketOBI, open Tools › PC bridge first (or turn on Settings › PC bridge at boot).
DESK_CONN_WARN_LEGACY: ⚠ Older firmware (pre-contract): some readings and verdicts may be missing or differ from this app. Update the PocketOBI firmware for full parity.
DESK_CONN_WARN_MISMATCH: ⚠ Firmware protocol v%s ≠ app v%s: verdicts may diverge. Update whichever side is older.
DESK_DIAG_FALSELOCK_CAUSE: a protection lockout (e.g. tripped over-discharge), not a real fault
DESK_DIAG_FALSELOCK_CHECK: the unlock should clear it and hold - charge afterwards to confirm
DESK_DIAG_FALSELOCK_OBS: charger lock set, but no hardware fault and no latched flag
DESK_DIAG_GAP_CAUSE: measured at rest, a wide gap points more to a drifting probe than to real heat
DESK_DIAG_GAP_CAUSE_RU: the board can legitimately run hotter right after charge or heavy use
DESK_DIAG_GAP_CHECK: compare each probe to an external thermometer to find which one is off
DESK_DIAG_GAP_CHECK_RU: let the pack rest to room temperature and re-read; if the gap remains, compare each probe to an external thermometer
DESK_DIAG_GAP_OBS: cell probe {tc:.0f} °C vs board probe {tm:.0f} °C - a {gap:.0f} °C temperature spread
DESK_DIAG_GATE_UNLOCK: An unlock should clear this lock.
DESK_DIAG_IMB_CAUSE: often drift a balance charge fixes; sometimes a weakening group
DESK_DIAG_IMB_CHECK: slow-charge and re-read - spread closes = drift, group {grp} stays low = weakening
DESK_DIAG_IMB_OBS: a {diff:.2f} V cell spread, group {grp} lowest
DESK_DIAG_LATCHED_CAUSE: the BMS has latched this fault; clearing it won't hold, it re-asserts on charge
DESK_DIAG_LATCHED_CHECK: unlock, then charge and watch - re-locks in ~10 s = real fault (bench work); holds = stale flag
DESK_DIAG_LATCHED_OBS: the BMS memorised a fault from a past event ({why})
DESK_DIAG_LATCHED_TITLE: BMS has a latched fault flag
DESK_DIAG_NOFAULT_OBS: no charger lock, no hardware fault, no latched flag
DESK_DIAG_SENSE_CAUSE: a dead group would pull the whole pack down, so this points to a broken sense (balance) lead on that group, not a dead cell
DESK_DIAG_SENSE_CHECK: measure group {grp} directly at the cells; if it is charged, inspect and reflow its sense lead
DESK_DIAG_SENSE_OBS: group {grp} reads ~0 V while the pack is alive ({pv:.0f} V)
DESK_DIAG_THERM_CAUSE: the reading is untrustworthy: most often a disconnected or dead {probe} thermistor
DESK_DIAG_THERM_CAUSE_RU: the reading is untrustworthy: most often a disconnected or dead {probe} thermistor, though a real extreme is just possible if the pack was stressed
DESK_DIAG_THERM_CHECK: re-read at room temperature; if it still reads this, check and replace the {name}
DESK_DIAG_THERM_CHECK_RU: let the pack settle to room temperature, then re-read; if it still reads this, check and replace the {name}
DESK_DIAG_THERM_OBS_ONE: the {name} reads {val:.0f} °C - an impossible value - while the {other_name} reads {other_v:.0f} °C
DESK_DIAG_WARM: pack is warm ({hi:.0f} °C) - let it cool for a clean resting diagnosis
DESK_DIAG_WARM_RU: pack is warm ({hi:.0f} °C) - normal after charge or heavy use
DESK_DIAG_WEAK_CAUSE: a tired group, or simply deeply discharged
DESK_DIAG_WEAK_CHECK: measure group {grp} with a DMM; try a gentle slow charge and re-read - if it will not hold above {vmin:.1f} V, it is failing
DESK_DIAG_WEAK_OBS: group {grp} reads {val:.2f} V, below the safe minimum
DESK_DIAG_WHY_UNCLEAR: cause unclear - see the Health counters
DESK_HIST_NO_BATTERIES:
No batteries yet.
Read a pack, or load demo data.
DESK_HIST_REPORT_EXPORTED: Exported %d reading(s) — paste it where you choose.
DESK_READ_FAIL_BRIDGE: Read failed (no response). The PocketOBI may have left PC bridge mode - check its screen shows 'USB bridge ACTIVE'.
DESK_RPR_OVERRIDE: Override: unlock anyway (fix the hardware first)
DESK_RPR_RECENTLY_USED: Pack was just charged or used (affects temperature)
DESK_RPR_RES_HEALTHY: Unlocked - the pack now reads healthy.
DESK_RPR_RES_REALFAULT: Charger lock cleared, but a hardware fault remains - the unlock cannot fix that.
DESK_RPR_RES_STILLLOCKED: Still locked after unlock - the BMS re-locked it.
DESK_RPR_RES_SUSPECT: Lock cleared, but a latched/soft fault remains - likely to re-lock on charge.
DESK_RPR_S1_DESC: Take a baseline reading before any repair.
DESK_RPR_S3_DESC: Clears the charger-lock nybble and recomputes the checksums, then commits and resets errors. The failure code is never touched. The arm is accepted once per insertion — if it fails, remove and reinsert the pack before retrying.
DESK_SET_CLEAR_MSG:
Delete ALL local readings, repair sessions
and battery records? This cannot be undone.
S_NOTHING_NO_WRITE: Nothing to repair - no write done.
S_NO_PACK_REPLY1: No pack reply. Check the adapter, the
S_NO_PACK_REPLY2: DATA/ENABLE wiring, or a dead BMS.
S_PC_HELP2: your PC, pick the Arduino OBI
S_RETRY_REINSERT: To retry, remove & reinsert the pack.
S_WARN_WRITES_FLASH: WARNING: writes to the BMS flash.
